market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure into Q4 as fourth RBA hike lands, housing data deteriorates, and Iran war keeps a lid on risk appetite. Iron ore shakeout and construction contagion (Bathla) add downside. Small-cap momentum and gold offer pockets of relative strength. Expect ^AXJO to test lower supports.
market_outlook.long_term: Bull case (#37) intact if RBA pauses and housing stabilises by mid-2027. Energy transition and AI capex cycles provide structural tailwinds. However, construction fragility, Big Four audit risks, and Victoria debt warnings cap upside. Canada outperforming Australia on per-capita GDP (#39) signals structural productivity concerns.
